notes.title: Ver.1.0.5 Hotfix is now live!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing POGO Stadium!

We’ve just released a Hotfix update (Ver.1.0.5). This update addresses an issue discovered during our internal debugging where the game would sometimes fail to recognize controllers when multiple controllers are connected.



◆ Fixes

Fixed an issue where controllers would not be recognized when multiple controllers are connected

Your feedback is always welcome, please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/

notes.title: Ver.1.0.4 Patch is now live!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing POGO Stadium!  

We’ve just released a new patch (Ver.1.0.4).  

Thanks to community reports and shared Player.log files, we were able to identify and fix the root cause of the loading screen issue.  



◆ Fixes  

Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck on the loading screen when using certain system language or region settings  


Your feedback has been a huge help in improving the game.  

Please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇  

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/

notes.title: We have updated Demo version 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
Hey, we just updated Demo version 1.0.1!

◆ Changes 

Implemented the main theme BGM – it’s an upbeat, energetic track!

Added the opening video.

Added a special bonus video that plays after clearing the final stage.

     ※ Even if you’ve already cleared it, you can watch it by clearing the final stage again.

Added a counter display for post-clear “completion challenge” elements.

Improved several in-game effects.

Fixed an issue where the rhythm was off in some BGM tracks.

Fixed various other bugs.





◆ Bugs or feedback? 

Let us know what you think! 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/



Thanks for always supporting “POGO Stadium”! 

We appreciate it and hope you keep enjoying it.
